launch_evidence.quote: Datroway 14 n/m n/m ● Uptake from breast cancer following launch in the US

notes: Scope: AstraZeneca's Product Revenue line for Datroway in 'Table 3: Product Revenue by medicine' (the medicine's total as AstraZeneca reports it). It combines AstraZeneca's own Product Sales (printed separately in the regional Product Sales table only from FY 2025, 1-5 $m) and Alliance Revenue (AstraZeneca's share of Daiichi Sankyo's sales, shown in the same table under 'Alliance Revenue included above'). It is not Daiichi Sankyo's net sales of the product. Approved in Japan (December 2024) and the US (17 January 2025); first revenue Q1 2025.
search_log: Listed AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 901832) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (2,057 filings, 1,620 of them Form 6-K). Located the quarterly results announcements with EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 901832 for each of 'Imjudo', 'Orpathys', 'Datroway' and 'Seroquel XR' (all forms, 2001-2026, yearly windows); every Form 6-K HTML hit was fetched from sec.gov (202 documents) and every table row parsed (bs4).

Quarter figure = the first 'Datroway' row of 'Table 3: Product Revenue by medicine'; in Q1 announcements the table has a single quarter column; in H1/9M/FY announcements the quarter is the second $m column (header e.g. 'H1 2025 % Change Q2 2025 % Change'), and both figures are quoted.
Full-year check FY 2025: 4+11+24+40=79 vs printed 78 (rounding of printed figures).
No Datroway revenue row exists before the Q1 2025 announcement (FY 2024 announcement 2025-02-06 lists Datroway only in the regulatory table).
